summary: Onity Group Inc. filed an 8-K on October 20, 2026, disclosing via Items 7.01 and 8.01 that it commenced a declaratory judgment action in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of New York seeking clarification of a New York mortgage servicing regulation governing optional expedited payment fees. The filing states no transaction terms, stake, price, premium, board recommendation or advisor. Onity notes prior regulator information requests on fee practices and ongoing discussions with New York regulators. Mechanics center on constitutional fair-notice and objective-standards arguments over undefined regulatory language. What to watch: regulatory outcomes and potential fee-related exposure rather than deal arbitrage.
